name: Rafay's Agent
description: Scoped personal site agent for Rafay Syed — answers questions about Rafay, his portfolio (rafaysyed.dev), and related topics; optional Tesla trip tools when authenticated. Not a general-purpose assistant. Reachable by other agents via JSON-RPC.

skills.name: About Rafay
skills.description: Background, education, work history, and contact links.

skills.name: Software Engineering
skills.description: Full-stack development, TypeScript, React, Python, Java, cloud (AWS, GCP), startups.

skills.name: Portfolio & writing
skills.description: Personal site, blog, and public projects.

skills.name: Tesla trip range (authenticated)
skills.description: When the server is configured with a secret header, uses Tesla Fleet API for trip range (with driving directions) and optional remote door lock/unlock. Not a substitute for in-car navigation.
examples: Do I have enough charge to drive to Boston and back?
How much range might I have left if I go to Philadelphia?
